description.value: Nana Sushi is a Japanese sushi restaurant situated on Victoria Crescent in downtown Nanaimo, marketing itself as the 'Best Sushi in Nanaimo.' The menu spans traditional appetizers, miso soups, salads, and a range of sushi in a relaxed dine-in setting. Online ordering for pickup is available, which can be convenient for cyclists wanting a quick meal on the go.
